Starting today, Saved Views is available to every customer on all paid plans. If you've ever rebuilt the same filtered, sorted, or grouped list over and over, this feature is for you. Now you can capture that exact configuration—filters, sort order, grouping, and columns—and return to it instantly, without setting it up again.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you have plenty of room to organize views around projects, sprints, clients, or personal workflows. Need a specific view for standups, another for planning, and one more for reporting? Now you can keep them all ready to go.

Saved Views also make collaboration easier. Any view you create can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters from scratch. This keeps reporting consistent and helps new teammates get up to speed faster, since they can simply open a shared view rather than reconstruct one on their own.

We think this small change will make a real difference in your daily workflow. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
